definitions.explanation: A physically attractive woman. Slightly literary or formal compared to neutral {美人|びじん}; often used in set phrases, news headlines, and entertainment-industry contexts.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{美女|びじょ}だ。
パーティーには{美女|びじょ}が{大勢|おおぜい}{集|あつ}まっていた。
examples.english: Many beautiful women had gathered at the party.

examples.japanese: {昔話|むかしばなし}には、{王子|おうじ}が{呪|のろ}いをかけられた{美女|びじょ}を{救|すく}う{場面|ばめん}がよく{出|で}てくる。
examples.english: In old folk tales, scenes often appear in which a prince rescues a beautiful woman who has been put under a curse.

notes:
Slightly more literary and formal than {美人|びじん}. Common in titles, headlines, idioms, and fairy-tale contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶世|ぜっせい}の{美女|びじょ}: a peerless beauty
- {美女|びじょ}と{野獣|やじゅう}: Beauty and the Beast
- {美女|びじょ}{揃|そろ}い: a gathering of beautiful women
- {才色兼備|さいしょくけんび}の{美女|びじょ}: a beauty with both talent and looks

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {美人|びじん}: beautiful woman — the most neutral, everyday term
- {美少女|びしょうじょ}: beautiful young girl — emphasizes youth
- イケメン: handsome man — male counterpart in casual speech
